question: The full form of IIP is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Index of Industrial Production.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• 
 The **Index **of **Industrial Production (IIP)** is a measure of the pace of **economic growth **experienced by various industry sectors over a **predetermined time period**.
 
 
• 
 The** Central Statistical Organization (CSO) **calculates and releases the IIP index **once **a **month**.
 
 
• 
 IIP is a composite **indicator **that **gauges **the **rate **of **expansion **of **industry groups **that are categorised as,

 
 
• 
 The **three broad** industries of** mining, manufacturing, **and **electricity**
 
 
• 
 Use-based industries, specifically the** Basic Goods, Capital Goods, **and **Intermediate Goods sectors.**
 
 
• 
 **IIP statistics **are currently calculated using** 2004–2005 **as the base year. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• IIP provides the **economic growth rates **for several industry groupings over a given time frame.
 
• These are the categories under which the **industrial groupings **it **measures **are categorised:
 
 
• Broad industries including** mining, manufacturing, **and **power.**
 
• Use-based industries that produce** infrastructure, capital goods, basic products, intermediate goods, consumer durables, **and **consumer non-durables.**
 
 
 
• About **40% **of the weight of the **commodities **covered in the IIP are made up of the **eight main industries **of India.
 
• The **eight core industries **or **sectors **are:
 
 
• Electricity
 
• Steel
 
• Refinery products
 
• Crude oil
 
• Coal
 
• Cement
 
• Natural gas
 
• Fertilizers.
